questions.segment: What kind of business do you run — a shop or service, a professional office, several branches, or a workshop/factory?
questions.city: Which city is your business in?
questions.employee_count: How many people work in your business?
questions.num_sites: How many locations or branches do you have?
questions.has_gstin: Is your business registered for GST?
questions.current_internet: What internet do you use today — business broadband, home broadband, a mobile hotspot, a leased line, or none?
questions.needs: Anything else you need — for example customer Wi-Fi, CCTV cameras or a website? You can also say no, or “not sure”.

notices.WELCOME: Hi! Just a few quick questions, then you'll see your plan and monthly price. Please don't share ID numbers or phone numbers here.
notices.CITY_UNKNOWN: I don't know that city yet. Could you tell me the nearest big city?
notices.INVALID_VALUE: That doesn't look right — could you check it?
notices.INJECTION_REFUSED: I can only help you choose a plan; I can't change prices or share internal information. Let's continue.
notices.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: Switching to quick questions so you can carry on.
notices.TURN_LIMIT: Let's finish with a few quick questions.
notices.MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: That message is a bit long — please keep it short.
notices.LANGUAGE_FALLBACK: Sorry, I'll continue in English for now.
notices.PII_REMOVED: I removed an ID or contact number from your message — you won't need it until checkout.
notices.DONE: Here is the plan I recommend.
notices.UNSURE_PICKED: No problem — I'll go with what suits most businesses like yours. You can change it later.
notices.UNSURE_ROUGH: No problem — a rough answer is fine.
notices.REFINE: Sure — a few quick questions to fine-tune your plan. You can say “not sure” to any of them.
notices.WELCOME_BACK: Welcome back! Let's carry on where you left off.
notices.PLAN_UPDATED: I've updated your plan — the changes are highlighted below.
notices.PLAN_SAME: Your plan stays the same. To change it, tell me what's different — for example “we have six staff” or “two branches”.
notices.SEGMENT_UNCLEAR: I couldn't tell what kind of business that is. Is it a shop or local service, a professional office (clinic, CA, lawyer), several branches, or a workshop/factory?
notices.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it another way?
notices.STAFF_RANGE: Please give the number of people as {min} to {max} — if it's just you, say {min}. For a bigger team, tap “Have someone call me”.
notices.SITES_RANGE: Please give the number of locations as {min} to {max}. For more, tap “Have someone call me”.

reasons.TIER_NOT_SERVED: not available in your city yet
reasons.GSTIN_UNVERIFIED: unlocks once your GSTIN is verified at checkout
reasons.FIBRE_NOT_FEASIBLE: fibre isn't available at your address

explanation.intro: Based on what you told me, I recommend:
explanation.total: That is ₹{monthly} per month plus ₹{setup} one-time setup, on a {months}-month contract (GST included).

why.internet: Your main internet connection — one for each location (you have {sites}).
why.lines: You said {staff} staff → {qty} SIMs, one for every {per} people.
why.per_person: One for each person (you said {staff} staff).
why.cameras: Two cameras for each location (you have {sites}).
why.per_10_staff: One for every {per} people (you said {staff} staff).
why.segment: Most businesses like yours use this.
